notes: Current website scope is ETF + major indices only. No individual-stock or delisted-stock market database is required. Public/no-key macro, rates, liquidity, CFTC positioning and public news context are automated. Canonical ETF price history has an open-licensed HF Data Library route; proprietary headline indices remain separately licensing-gated.

market_history_etfs.scope: SPY, QQQ, DIA, S&P 500 11 sector ETFs, plus verified optional ETF proxies such as QTEC
market_history_etfs.public_rule: HF Data Library publishes the dataset under CC BY 4.0; output is published only with attribution and the documented March-2022 PiTrading-to-IEX source break preserved.
market_history_etfs.credential: HFDL_API_KEY GitHub Actions secret; provider currently issues free keys that expire every 30 days

market_history_headline_indices.scope: S&P 500, Nasdaq-100, Nasdaq Composite, DJIA proprietary index series
market_history_headline_indices.public_rule: Do not synthesize or relabel ETF proxies as the proprietary index series. Add only a source whose public-display/static-redistribution rights are verified.
market_history_headline_indices.fallback: SPY/QQQ/DIA may be displayed only as clearly labelled ETF proxies, not as the indices themselves.

market_snapshot.provider: derived from verified_publishable ETF market history
market_snapshot.public_rule: Derived only from approved market history or another approved display source

sector_taxonomy.notes: S&P 500 11-sector ETFs are mapped. Nasdaq-100 and Dow Jones U.S. sector codes are added only after exact official mapping is verified.

official_public_bundle.provider: BLS / U.S. Treasury / Federal Reserve Board / NY Fed / World Bank / OECD, with SEC attempted fail-soft
official_public_bundle.refresh: daily GitHub Actions plus manual dispatch
official_public_bundle.rights: official/open public data only; source failures remain explicit

financial_conditions_and_liquidity.provider: U.S. Treasury Fiscal Data / NY Fed / Federal Reserve public series
financial_conditions_and_liquidity.coverage: TGA operating cash, repo/reverse-repo operations, Fed assets, reserve balances, IORB and target range

futures_positioning.provider: U.S. Commodity Futures Trading Commission Public Reporting Environment
futures_positioning.coverage: pinned CFTC contract codes for E-mini S&P 500, Nasdaq Mini, DJIA x $5, Russell E-mini, USD Index and UST 10Y Note
futures_positioning.metric: contract counts and long-minus-short balances; not dollar flows or ETF flows

sec_identifiers.notes: SEC currently returns HTTP 403 to the hosted GitHub runner. Full ticker mapping is not required for the present ETF/index website scope, so this remains fail-soft rather than blocking publication.

news_recent.provider: GDELT DOC 2.0 plus official Federal Reserve/BLS release feeds where upstream access succeeds
news_recent.window: GDELT rolling 3 months; official feeds latest releases
news_recent.metric: aggregate topic coverage plus official release headlines/links only; no article bodies republished

news_deep_history.provider: GDELT bulk Event/GKG or licensed/archive source
news_deep_history.notes: DOC 2.0 is only a rolling recent window; deep history needs a separate bulk ingestion route rather than pretending the recent API covers old dates.
